name: Erik Mesic
headline: Student at NYU Stern — Accounting | CPA Track — Pre-Law
summary: I study accounting and the intersection of business, law, and governance. My work spans legislative advocacy, educational reform, debate, and quantitative research.
about: I am an undergraduate at NYU Stern in the Certified Public Accounting track with minors in Mathematics and Computer Science. I pursue research and practical work at the intersection of policy, law, and financial modeling. Outside of school, I enjoy debate, photography, and community education projects.
